# Pitch-model golden for opensvr-voice (Phase 5, pitch stage).
# Re-dumped after aligning the pitch feature normalization with the OpenSV+
# z-score convention: (value - mean) / standard deviation. The fork's
# multiplication by the deviation left the network input out of range.
# Re-dumped with the Rust PitchModel (a bit-exact port of the C++ f0model-dds
# path) against the GUMI AI voice. The voice archive itself is proprietary and stays behind
# OPENSVR_TEST_VOICE; only these small text goldens are committed.
# Input lines start with "in " (<language> <midi> <seconds> <phoneme>...),
# followed by the timing stage's real predicted durations and the expected
# per-frame absolute MIDI pitch (5 ms grid from time zero).
in japanese 60 0.4 k a
in japanese 62 0.6 s a
in japanese 60 0.2 sil
in japanese 67 0.3 a
